parts.label: Input 8
parts.prompt: If the user types 8 at line 00, what does OUT [1] print?

fields.label: printed
fields.hint: Trace: 8→4→2→1→0. Count how many times you passed line 09.

traps.hint: Four halvings of 8 would mean counting wrong; 8→4→2→1→0 is three successful loop bodies.
The program prints the counter in [1], not the original input.

parts.label: Input 10
parts.prompt: If the user types 10, what is printed?

parts.label: Summary
parts.prompt: How many successful loop rounds (lines 06–09) run for input 8?

fields.label: rounds
fields.hint: Each round stores a new halved value in [0] and adds 1 to [1].
